description:
The biggest fundraising mistake in a bad economy isn't the economy itself — it's accidentally convincing your donors you're sinking. Here's how to fix it before you lose donor trust for good.

📌 Join Fundraising FastTrack
Build a repeatable fundraising system that helps your nonprofit raise sustainable funding—not just one-time grants.
👉 https://www.causespecialists.ca

If donor dollars feel tight right now, it's easy for fear to creep into your emails, updates, and campaigns without you even noticing. In this video, fundraising expert Joanne Toler (30+ years helping small nonprofits raise millions) breaks down the exact mistake most nonprofit leaders make during uncertain economic times — and the 3 simple habits that protect donor relationships instead.

You'll learn:
✅ Why fear-based messaging quietly destroys donor confidence
✅ The 3 habits that keep donors engaged during a tough economy (Stay Calm, Stay Connected, Stay Consistent)
✅ A real example of how one nonprofit leader grew donations during economic uncertainty
✅ What to say (and NOT say) in your next donor email

If you're a nonprofit leader worried about fundraising during a recession or economic downturn, this video will change how you communicate with your donors — starting today.

🔔 Subscribe for weekly fundraising strategy, donor psychology, and grant writing tips for small nonprofits.

#NonprofitFundraising #DonorRetention #FundraisingTips
